facts.fact: The Ministry of Finance says a 2025 amendment to Section 4 of the Tax Procedures Code Act provides for the NIN as the tax identification number for individuals, and a three-phase transition to NIN-based taxpayer login is under way.
The Ministry of Finance says that as of 30 September 2026, 2,130,814 NINs had been mapped to TINs out of 5,405,148 individual taxpayer records, about 39.4%.

note: CC 2026-10-22: the NIN-to-TIN mapping count revalued from matching:reported to register:inservice, as UGA-003 holds the same figure; a count of records mapped is not a figure from checking a register against the ID.
